test_scenarios.name: high_confidence_fact
test_scenarios.expected_behavior: Direct answer without hedging, no metadata leaking

test_scenarios.name: low_confidence_fact
test_scenarios.expected_behavior: Hedging response (maybe, I think, not sure) if confidence low, or admits not knowing

test_scenarios.name: very_recent
test_scenarios.query: What did we just talk about?
test_scenarios.expected_behavior: References recent conversation, prioritizes recent items

test_scenarios.name: old_fact
test_scenarios.expected_behavior: States fact without mentioning age of information

test_scenarios.name: multiple_facts
test_scenarios.expected_behavior: Combines multiple facts naturally, no metadata leaking

test_scenarios.name: conflicting_confidence
test_scenarios.query: What do you know about my family?
test_scenarios.description: Query with high and low confidence items mixed
test_scenarios.expected_behavior: Weights appropriately, hedges on uncertain items

test_scenarios.name: no_memory
test_scenarios.expected_behavior: Answers from general knowledge, ignores empty memory context

test_scenarios.name: ambiguous
test_scenarios.expected_behavior: Lists known preferences without listing metadata

test_scenarios.name: followup_confidence
test_scenarios.expected_behavior: Shows confidence awareness without quoting symbols/emojis

test_scenarios.name: multiturn_consistency
test_scenarios.setup_query: What do you know about me?
test_scenarios.expected_behavior: Consistent behavior across turns, no metadata leaking
